caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object with a central oval shape. The object features a border that consists of a thick, dark brown outline, followed by a thin light beige layer, and then a wider brown, gold, and light brown patterned band. At each corner of the rectangle, there are clusters of green and teal leaves with brown branches or tendrils. Inside the central oval area, there is a symmetrical arrangement of floral motifs. At the center, two large flowers are visible: one is red and the other is purple, both surrounded by green, gold, and blue leaves. Additional smaller flowers and buds in shades of red and purple are interspersed throughout the design, forming a wreath-like pattern within the oval. The background inside the oval is a muted grayish beige color, which contrasts with the brighter colors of the flowers and leaves. The entire composition is framed by a thick black border.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
